content:
lee_support: FYI customer ACME-Analytics reporting transient 5xx + sudden latency spikes, then subsequent requests routed to a different region and provoked billing anomalies. saw hedged requests in logs. :confused:
ash_sdk: Can you paste the sample request_id and any SDK config they used? hedged behavior + geo-hops sounds like our client-side hedging + router fallback interacting badly. :thinking_face:
maria_sre: request_id: req_0a1b2c3d, logs show: `route_decision: us-central1 -> eu-west1 (fallback)` and `hedged=true` on the same incoming request. timestamps: 2025-11-04T15:12:03Z -> 15:12:03.120 -> 15:12:03.350 (second hedge).
lee_support: customer said they had `hedged: true` turned on in SDK (default for their version) and custom backoff set to very aggressive: `initial=5ms, max=50ms, jitter=0`. They have short timeouts 100ms.
nash_sdk: ugh that config would fire near-instant hedges. if the first goes to us-central and router can't allocate slot it triggers fallback to eu-west and the hedge fires too, causing two in-flight requests to different regions. that explains double billing + double work.
jon_platform: attaching router trace: `trace_id: t-9f7e`; decision graph shows no affinity pin because client didn't send `x-region-hint`. router policy then picked fallback region when first allocation timed out. both hedges reached router before the first allocation completed.
lee_support: customer repro steps (from them):
1) set SDK hedged:true, initial backoff 5ms, timeout 100ms
2) saturate us-central with a small load (10 req/s but low slots) so first allocation queues ~70ms
3) watch client fire hedge to eu-west on 2nd attempt -> observable double charge.
nash_sdk: thanks. can we get the exact SDK headers from that req?
maria_sre: headers from req_0a1b2c3d: `Authorization: Bearer xxxxx`, `x-client-version: sdk-js-1.4.2`, `x-hedged: 1`, `x-region-hint: ` (empty), `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`.
ash_sdk: confirms: sdk-js-1.4.2 introduced aggressive hedging default for short timeouts. we shipped a change in 1.4.x that made hedged default for text generation. this customer on old plan had low concurrency so backpressure + short timeout triggers cross-region hedges.
jon_platform: recommended mitigation: router should respect `x-client-affinity` or `x-region-hint` if present. but also we should consider a server-side debounce that suppresses hedged second attempt if the first is still pending at allocation-stage and would route to a different region. that would avoid double-execution billing.
lee_support: customer asked for an immediate workaround. suggested steps I gave them: downgrade to sdk-js-1.3.x or set `hedged:false` or increase client timeout to 500ms and set `initial_backoff >= 50ms`. they tried `hedged:false` and issue stopped. :white_check_mark:
nash_sdk: action items for SDK team: 1) emergency patch to 1.4.3 to change hedging defaults (make opt-in), 2) document cross-region hedging caveat in FAQ, 3) add explicit header `x-region-hint` for our quickstart to encourage affinity.
maria_sre: action items for platform: 1) add soft debounce at router allocation path to avoid cross-region duplicate execution billing (short-term), 2) add metric/alert for requests with `hedged=true` that result in multi-region execution, 3) create a billing safe-guard to detect near-simultaneous executions and surface to billing team.
jon_platform: I can take the router debounce prototype. will add a flag to only suppress hedges when allocation state is PENDING and the alternate region would be different. Expect PR by EOD tomorrow. :hammer_and_wrench:
lee_support: I'm sending the customer a writeup with repro + workaround and ETA for SDK patch and platform debounce.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: router-debounce-proto -> staging (job 4582).
nash_sdk: small repro snippet customer used (JS):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ hedged: true, timeoutMs: 100, backoff: { initial: 5, max: 50, jitter: true } });
await client.generate({ model: 'rw1-large', prompt: 'hi' });
```
nash_sdk: note to self: we should change example in README from `hedged:true` to `hedged:false` and add region hint example: `new Redwood({ regionHint: 'us-central1' })`.
maria_sre: can engineering also produce a small log grep we can run for forensic on customer logs? sample: `rg "hedged=true" | rg -B 2 "route_decision"`
lee_support: thanks everyone. pinging @billing to check if they can refund the duplicate execution for req_0a1b2c3d. :pray:
jon_platform: linking ticket: PLAT-7892 for debounce + metric. assigning to me.
lee_support: marking this thread for follow-up once SDK patch and router debounce are in staging. :eyes:
nash_sdk: will open SDK PR and post link here.
lee_support: resolved for now with customer workaround. will update when patches land. :white_check_mark:
